name: Crocodile
overview: The biblical references to the crocodile, often identified with the leviathan, reveal God's sovereign power over even the most formidable creatures. Scripture portrays leviathan as a mighty and fearsome beast that only the Lord can control or defeat, as seen in Job's challenge to draw it out and God's promise to punish it with a great sword. These passages underscore God's supreme authority over creation, from the beginning when He created the heavens and the earth, to the ultimate revelation of His victory over evil.
